name: 视频编解码器分析
description: 检查视频编码模式和编解码器伪影，以检测重新编码和篡改痕迹。
useCase: Detecting video 篡改 through codec fingerprint and encoding history 分析
mechanism: 分析 video container 元数据, codec parameters, quantization 模式, and encoding 伪影. Manipulated videos often show signs of re-encoding (double 压缩伪影), mismatched codec parameters, or encoding 模式 inconsistent with claimed source devices.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 73-85% on re-encoded and manipulated videos
source: Stamm, M. et al. (2012) - Anti-Forensics of Digital Image Compression, IEEE TIFS
algorithm: Container Analysis + Codec Parameter Extraction + Double Compression Detection + Encoding Pattern Matching
parameters: Codecs: H.264/H.265/VP9/AV1, QP 分析: block-level, GOP structure: reference frame 模式
strengths:
• 检测编解码器级别的篡改痕迹
• 发现重新压缩的证据
• 检测视觉不可见的操作
• 与其他取证方法互补
limitations:
• 需要编解码器特定知识
• 不适用于未压缩视频
• 多次重新编码消除证据
• 需要适应新编解码器

references.title: Stamm, M. et al. (2012). Anti-Forensics of Digital Image Compression. IEEE TIFS.
Jiang, X. et al. (2013). In-Loop and Out-of-Loop Filter Decision Detection in HEVC Compressed Video. IEEE SPL.
Vazquez-Padin, D. et al. (2020). Detection of Video Double Encoding with GOP Size Estimation. WIFS.
